container: background-color: #fdf6f0; padding: 40px 14px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
card: background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px 20px; margin: 0 0 32px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(242, 139, 168, 0.10)
p: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.85; color: #5a4a42; margin: 0 0 16px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: display: inline-block; background-color: #fce8ee; color: #d96687; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 22px; margin: 0 0 18px; text-align: left
h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #5a4a42; text-align: left; margin: 24px 0 12px
blockquote: background-color: #fce8ee; border-radius: 14px; padding: 15px 18px; margin: 0 0 16px; color: #8b5f59; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.8; text-align: left
pre: background-color: #faf0e8; border: 1px solid #f0e2d8; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; margin: 0 0 16px; overflow-x: auto
code: color: #5a4a42; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
inline_code: background-color: #fce8ee; color: #d96687; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
list_item: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.85; color: #5a4a42; margin: 0 0 10px; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: background-color: #fce8ee; color: #d96687; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #f0e2d8; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px; word-break: break-word
td: border: 1px solid #f0e2d8; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px; color: #5a4a42; word-break: break-word
